children: Shares of ADARx Pharmaceuticals are due to make their trading debut Friday after the clinical-stage biotechnology company's upsized initial public offering was priced at the high end of expectations, raising about $446.3 million.
ADARx late Thursday said it is selling nearly 26.3 million shares at $17 apiece in the offering, compared with prior plans to offer about 21.9 million shares at between $15 and $17 each.
The San Diego company's shares are slated to begin trading later Friday on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ADRX.
